explanation: API lemma with a Lean proof, the B ⇔ P part of Proposition 1 in Abrate–Barbero–Cerruti–Murru (arXiv 1601.03081), from B + P = (a+1)(b+1)/2. The paper assumes a and b are both odd; the Lean version assumes only a odd, which is enough because (a+1)/2 is then an integer, as the docstring notes. Faithful.
